description: Cancels a ride at the customer's explicit request. A request still waiting for the email click is deleted with every ride behind the same Confirm link. Requests Feminiq Rides has not confirmed yet and unpaid payment requests are cancelled at once (the customer gets an email). Paid bookings are passed to Feminiq Rides as a cancellation request, which she handles under the Terms (deposit returned more than 24 hours before pickup; within 24 hours the 25% deposit is kept). Needs the bookingId and the customer's email. Ask the customer to confirm before calling.

email.description: The customer's email address used for the booking (proves it is their booking).

name: cancel_booking
title: Cancel a booking
